author: (A. d'Orbigny, 1846)

note.en: A round white lucine buried in sand; four museum samples from Punta Cahuita and the Puerto Vargas shore, listed in the catalogue as Codakia costata.
note.es: Una lucina blanca y redonda enterrada en la arena; cuatro muestras de museo de Punta Cahuita y la costa de Puerto Vargas, citada en el catálogo como Codakia costata.

evidence: GBIF: 4 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica (REGAMA and Cahuita catalogue), Avicennia
